current.text: Josh projects Risacher as the 10th man in the Dallas rotation, maybe lower.
His minutes kept dropping through last season.
Dallas has too many wings and forwards who expect minutes, so frontcourt minutes are crowded.

durable.text: Risacher is a low-usage forward who rarely passes and gets under four rebounds.
His game is like Harrison Barnes: he hits threes, scores at a mediocre level and adds little else.
His free throw shooting has fallen off and is a weak spot.

note: Risacher is not a draft target. Both sites value him at 0 USD, his ranks are 246 on Yahoo and 216 on ESPN (only 144 players are drafted here), and he was not drafted in our league last season. His projected line of about 1.5 threes and 10 points in roughly 22 minutes gives no category a real lift, and his FT% (68 percent) and assists are weak. Only follow him if injuries in the crowded Dallas forward group push his minutes up early in the season.
